title: Prophet's Hill
wikitext:
'''Prophet's Hill'''<ref>{{questlong|Neutral|60R|The White Stag|class=druid}}</ref> is a hill overlooking the southern road in [[Hyjal]] past [[Darkhollow Pass]]. It is where the Prophet [[Medivh]] met with the leaders of the [[Night elf|night elves]], [[Alliance]], and [[Horde]] to unite them under the banner of the [[Great Alliance]] in order to defeat the [[Burning Legion]] at the end of the [[Third War]]. The [[Fourth Feather of Medivh]] can be found here.
